capabilities: Sort nested objects and arrays recursively up to 5 levels
Run via a command palette command on the current file
extras: Technical details are in a separate README_DEV.md; the author deliberately omits a settings tab and ribbon icon, so the plugin is command-palette only.
problem: Obsidian lets notes accumulate frontmatter properties in arbitrary order, and there is no built-in way to reorder them alphabetically, including nested structures.
summary: Command-based plugin that alphabetically sorts YAML frontmatter keys, including nested objects and arrays, up to five levels deep.
